Hey, welcome aboard
The internet, the way it should be.

Blocked sites, apps that won’t load, a VPN that drops every five minutes? Yeah, we know the feeling. Aether+ gets you through with a single tap, and if the line drops, it gets back up on its own so you don’t have to babysit it.
One tap and you’re in. No setup marathon.
No sign-up, no account, no email.
Speaks English and Persian, in dark or light.
Show me how
Smart mode
You don’t need to be a network nerd.
Smart mode looks at what your network is blocking, then picks the protocol that actually gets through: MASQUE, WireGuard or WARP×2. If it smells DPI, it switches on obfuscation by itself.
Reads your network first, then picks the route.
Anti-DPI tricks kick in only when they’re needed.
Want the wheel? Every knob is still waiting in Settings.
Nice, what else?
Plan B, C and D
Road blocked? We’ll take another one.
Some days WARP alone won’t cut it. Stack Aether with Psiphon and Tor: seven routes in total, picked right from the home screen. And you see the whole path live: you, the hops, the internet.
7 routes, from fast and simple to maximum stealth.
Your route and live speed, right on the home screen.
Heads up: every extra hop costs a little speed.
Got it
Your data, your call
One last thing, then you’re in.

Logs and session history stay on this phone, and you can wipe them any time from Diagnostics and Automation. The first time you connect, Android will ask whether to allow a VPN. That’s the system keeping you in control, so go ahead and tap OK.
Diagnostics and history never leave your phone.
Android asks for VPN permission just once. Tap OK.
If we ask about notifications, say yes: that’s where your live speed shows up.
Let’s go
